cues: Zinc sulphide has molar mass ninety seven point four, so we have two moles.
Each zinc sulphide gives one sulphur dioxide: two moles, forty four point eight litres at S T P.
And each gives one zinc: two times sixty five point four, one hundred and thirty point eight grams.
